description.value: Nubo Kitchen + Bar is a Japanese fusion restaurant in the historic Janion building near the Johnson Street Bridge in downtown Victoria, serving fresh sushi, sashimi, ramen, tapas-style sharing plates, and modern cocktails since 2019. Part of the multi-location Nubo Group, the kitchen blends traditional Japanese technique with global influences and sources from local and international ingredient partners. Walk-ins are welcome during quieter hours, making it a natural downtown refueling stop for cyclists arriving without a reservation.
